steps.npc: We're learnin' to live a bit differently now that the Angel's gone... It feels a little odd, but we be makin' the best of it.
For example, thanks t' some notes that Keenan left behind, we've worked out how to make golems out o' sunstone. They do nay do much right now, but we reckon we can eventually make use of 'em.
Aye. Feel free to give it a go yoursen if you fancy.

steps.text: If the player has the sunstone crystal, or if they have already built the bank chest with it:
If the player has lost the sunstone crystal and has free inventory space:

steps.npc: Oh, by the way, one o' the others managed to find this sunstone crystal. 'ere, you can have it.

steps.text: Cormac hands you a sunstone crystal.

steps.npc: We weren't sure what t' do with it. Figured you'd have an inkling as you've been digging around the place.

steps.player: I can't say I've seen much reference to something like this, but I'll see what use I can make of it. Thanks, Cormac.

steps.text: If the player has lost the sunstone crystal, but does not have any inventory space:

steps.npc: Oh, by the way, one o' the others managed to find this sunstone crystal. Come back when you have space for it, and you can have it.
